verdict: Maybe. Soup X pitched soup-based meals on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. Soups are healthy and convenient, but Indian buyers mostly see soup as a starter, not a meal, so you'll need to change habits.
angle: Instant and ready-to-cook soups sell to office workers, students and health-conscious buyers. Winter brings a sales spike. Hearty, protein-rich soups can be positioned as meals, and quick commerce helps reach buyers.
